t: In front of you is Revolving Torsion, a kinetic sculpture and fountain made in 1972 and 73 by the Russian-born Constructivist Naum Gabo. It was commissioned for the Tate Gallery, and has been on long-term loan for display here at St Thomas' Hospital since 1975. It was given Grade II star listed status in January 2016. Gabo was a key figure in the Russian avant-garde, and a leading influence on twentieth-century sculpture, so this fountain is a rare chance to see his work out in the open.
